_comment: Classification rules for the signin / payment / transaction SMS channels.
sms_parser.py reloads this file when its mtime changes, so a provider that
changes its wording or separators can be handled by editing this file and
restarting the workers — no code change, no redeploy.
brands: matched against the message body first, then against the sender
address (which the SMS forwarder posts as `sender`). A brand decides the
family; the first matching entry wins, so keep the most specific first.
keywords.otp: a message needs one of these plus an extractable code before
it can be an OTP at all. Add wording here when a provider changes it.
keywords.signin: sign-in vocabulary, used when the sender/brand is unknown.
trx_anchors: the labels a transaction ID follows. The token right after the
anchor is read as the TRX ID.
senders: optional map for sender addresses that carry no brand name in the
body, e.g. a numeric gateway number. Keys are compared case-insensitively
and, for numeric addresses, digit for digit. Purely a hint — routing never
depends on it, so a provider changing its sender number cannot break.
